svg.aria-label: Explain one classifier from pixels to learning
svg.title: Explain one classifier from pixels to learning
svg.text: 1. How many patch rows? What changes when we add CLS?
2. Three heads: what is the width of one head’s message?
3. Dog/cat head: how many outputs and trainable parameters?
4. If the model is wrong, how does the loss reach the patch layer?
5. If we remove CLS, how will we form one image representation?
